**Treatment or tool** (its name, or the last part of its page address on outrunningageing.com/leaves/):

**What is wrong with the test, or with who settles it** (a loophole, an undefined word, a case it would wrongly count or wrongly miss; or, for a stage, the record that shows a different rung):

**What I would write instead:**

**A record, if the question is about a stage** (a link to the trial report, the approval notice or the registry entry):

How this gets folded in: a test is never edited once a stage or an estimate has been published against it, so a treatment whose test is wrong is retired and replaced by one with the corrected test, with a dated line in the changelog that cites this issue; a stage shown wrong by a record gets a dated revision on the treatment's page; or the question is answered here and the record left as it is. See outrunningageing.com/disagree/.
